Acknowledgments

EZ-InSAR’s team thanks:

  • the developers of the different SAR/InSAR processors.

Reference

Do not forget to cite EZ-InSAR and the different processors if you plan to publish your work:

  • Hrysiewicz, A., Wang, X. & Holohan, E.P. EZ-InSAR: An easy-to-use open-source toolbox for mapping ground surface deformation using satellite interferometric synthetic aperture radar. Earth Sci Inform 16, 1929-1945 (2023). https://doi.org/10.1007/s12145-023-00973-1
